title: bp-from-scratch
description: A from-scratch NumPy state-vector simulator (qsim) with exact parameter-shift and adjoint gradients, and a reproducible numerical study of barren plateaus in variational quantum circuits on 2-16 qubits: closed-form Haar references, cost-function and initialisation dependence, training under shot noise, QAOA and exact dynamical Lie algebras. Companion software and data to the report "Barren Plateaus from Scratch: A NumPy State-Vector Study of Trainability in Variational Quantum Circuits" (https://thanatchon36.github.io/bp-from-scratch/paper/).
